description.value: Snootli Creek Hatchery is a Fisheries and Oceans Canada facility operating under the federal Salmonid Enhancement Program, located in the Cariboo, Chilcotin and Central Interior region of British Columbia. Community hatcheries of this type typically support salmon and steelhead restoration and may offer informal educational visits, making them a potentially interesting cultural and ecological stop along remote cycling routes in the Bella Coola corridor.
